name: zilvereyes-plugin-studio
description: Preservation-first creation, installation, evaluation, comparison and portfolio management for Codex plugins and skills.

interface.longDescription: Create, inspect, install, evaluate and compare Codex plugins and skills without deleting upstream sources. Combines independent Zilvereyes workflows informed by the archived Skill Installer, Skill Creator, Plugin Eval and Plugin Creator sources while keeping provenance, licensing, App identities, MCP routes, marketplace state and rollback evidence separate.
defaultPrompt: Kortlæg mine plugin-kilder og arbejdslisten uden at slette noget.
Opret en ny plugin- eller skill-kandidat fra de valgte kilder uden at overskrive noget.
Vurder dette plugin eller denne skill og fortæl præcist, hvad der bør rettes først.
